propositions: Identity convention, probe classifier, and non-ADF-dependent sanitizers must be extracted from adapters/jira/ to a new public adapters/jira_family/ package to eliminate unsanctioned cross-adapter imports and establish acyclic dependency direction.

Jira_fields.py cannot relocate wholly because it imports from location-pinned modules adf.py and comment_limits.py; instead, relocate pure symbols (_sanitize_label, _sanitize_summary, _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK, value maps) and contract-parameterize the sanitizers that depend on vendor codec/limit objects.

The unified local-to-Jira status and priority maps must have exactly one definition site in jira_family/ to eliminate pre-existing drift; the status map adopts deleted→Done (matching outbound_fields.py, changing ACLI behavior from invalid Deleted string).

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) remain at their paths; adapters/jira/ and other adapters import jira_family/ symbols via absolute imports only, never relative, to survive spec_from_file_location synthetic-name loading.

The ACLI transport (acli*.py) changes only in import lines (aliased to preserve underscore names in __all__); probe.py binds Cloud's RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES to the relocated classifier; no re-export shims remain at old paths.
J1's characterization oracles (30 pinned tests) pass unmodified except one import re-point; the deliberate deleted→Done behavior change is pinned by a new test and documented.
